title: How to organize the coffee table | Living Room
description:
A small shared surface for whatever is happening right now, and nothing that is not.

This is the Coffee Table in the Living Room. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One tray holding four coasters and the remote in use, plus at most one book or one plant beside it. No mugs, no charging cables, no post, and the wood or glass showing across most of the top.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Clear the whole top onto the floor and put back only what somebody used in the last two days.
Straighten: The tray sets the table's entire standing inventory.
Shine: Lift the tray and wipe the whole top including the ring marks, then get the underside edge and the lower shelf
Safety: A glass top or a hard square corner sits at exactly the height of a toddler's forehead, so corner guards or a
Standardize: Photograph the finished tray and keep that picture as the reference for what clear means on this table.
Sustain: Whoever carries the last mug to the kitchen takes everything else that does not belong on the table with them,

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
If it does not fit on the tray, it does not live on the table.
